paite: Huan TOUPA'N Elijah pingpei a van a apitouh ding in, hichi ahong hi a, Gilgal a pan Elisha toh Elijah apawt uhi.
heading: Van A Elijah Laktouhna

paite: Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Hiai ah ana om dih; TOUPA'N Bethel a pai ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Elisha in, “TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in Bethel ah apaisukkhawm uhi.
Bethel a om zawlneite tapate Elisha kiang ah ahoh ua, akiang ah, "Tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia?” achi uh. Ama'n, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un," achi hi.

Elijah in akiang ah, "Elisha, hiai ah na om dih; TOUPA'N Jeriko a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi. K'on nuse kei hial ding,” achi hi. Huchi in Jeriko ah ahohkhawmta uhi.
Jeriko a om zawlneite tapate'n Elisha ava naih ua, akiang ah, tuni in TOUPA'N na heutupa ahon lakmangsak ding chih na thei hia? achi uh. Ama'n adawng a, "Hi, thei mah ing, dai un,” achi hi.

Elijah in akiang ah, "Hiai ah na om dih, TOUPA'N Jordan a hoh ding in ahon sawl," achi hi. Ama'n, "TOUPA hinna leh na hin bang in ka gen ahi, k'on nuse kei hial ding," achi hi. Huchi in anih un apaikhawmta uh.
Zawlneite' tapate lak a mi sawmnga ava hoh ua, amaute zawn, gamla kuamtak ah ava dingh ua; amau gel bel Jordan gei ah ana dingh uhi.
Elijah in apuan la in alomzial a, tui asat a, alang tuak ah ahong kikhenta a, huchi in anih un lei keu ah apaita uhi.
Agalkah nung un hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in Elisha kiang ah, "Na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om ma in bang ahia ka hon hihsak ding hon ngen in," achi hi. Elisha in, "Na kha tan nih tang leng,” achi hi.
Ama'n, "Thil haksapi ngen na hi ve; haksa mahleh na kiang a pan lakmang a ka om lai na muhleh na tang ding, na hon muh keileh bel na tang kei ding,” achi hi.
Apai kawmkawm ua, ahoulim lai un hichi ahong hi a, ngai in, mei kangtalai leh mei sakolte ahong kimu guih uhi. Akal ua kigolh in akikhensakta a; Elijah bel pingpei in van ah apaitouta hi.
Elisha in huai amu a, "Ka pa aw, ka pa aw, Israelte kangtalai leh asakol a tuangte aw!" chi in akikou hi. Huchi in Elijah amuta kei a; ama puan aman a, phel nih in abotkek hi.
Elijah puan hong kia leng atawm a, apaikik nawn a, Jordan lui gei ah adingh hi.
Elijah puan hong kia ala a, huai in tui asat a, "TOUPA, Elijah Pathian koi ah?" achi hi. Huchi a tui asattak in alang tuak ah hong kikhen a, Elisha agalkahta hi.
Jeriko a zawlneite tapate, amah zawn a omte'n amuh un, "Elijah kha Elisha tung ah atu mah ve," achi uhi. Amah mu ding in akuan ua, ama ah lei si in akunsuk uhi.

Amaute'n akiang ah, "Ngai in, na sikhate'n mi ngalhat pipi sawmnga ka ompih uh. Na heutupa zong ding in sawl ve. TOUPA Kha in latou ahi dia, koi lai tang ah hiam, koi lai phaizang ah hiam a khia khattou ahi mai ding," achi uh. Ama'n, "Kuansak ke'n," achi hi.
Zumhuai khop a anget nung un, "Kuansak ve ua,” achi khong hi. Huchi in mi sawmnga asawl ua; ni thum sung azong ua, himahleh amuzou kei uh.
Jeriko a anituan lai in akiang ah ahong nawn ua; ama'n akiang uah, na kiang uah, "Kuansak kei un, ka hon chi ahi kei maw?" achi hi.
Huai khua a mite'n Elisha kiang ah, "En in, hiai khomun anuam mahmah a, ka toupa un leng na hon muhpih hi. Himahleh tui ahoih kei a, agam mahmah gahsuah thei lou gam ahi," achi uhi.
heading: Elisha Thillamdang Hihte

paite: Ama'n, "Tuithawl thak hon la unla, chi thun un,” achi a; huchi in ahon la uhi.
Tuikhuk ah ava hoh a, chi athehlut a, “TOUPA'N hichi in achi, hiai tui ka limsakta, tuban siah sihna leh gahsuahlouhna a-om nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Elisha gen bang in tuni tan in huai tui alimta hi.
Huai a pan Bethel ah ahohtou a; lampi a apai lai in khua a pan pasal naupang hon ahong pawtkhia ua, ahong nuihsan ua, akiang ah, "Nang lugiaupa, va hohtou in, nang lugiaupa va hohtou in," achi uhi.
Anunglam anga a, amau amu a, TOUPA min in ahamsiatta hi. Huchi in gamnuai a pan vompinu nih ahong pawtkhia ua, alak ua naupang sawmli-le-nih abalgawp uhi.
Huai a pan Karmel tang ah ahoh a, huai a pan Samaria ah apai nawnta hi.
